posts.content_html_raw:
My personal highlight of the update.

I had a powerful hunch this was coming, and boy, I am not disappointed. At. All.

Looking cute here.

This absolutely solidified the Greatness of a Sana x Rin relationship in my mind. Hilariously, Rin is apparently younger than Sana, though I'm not entirely sure I've remembered right. All in all, peak fiction.

Moving on to the update proper, here are some thoughts I've written down while playing, in the order I had them through the update:
My boy Pareidolia, you're about as callous as HOPE. I guess that fits since you basically confirmed you guys constitute a trinitary entity with Wires. You're more of a dick than I thought, however. I kinda feel like telling you to fuck off.

Hm... Saki mentioned... it seemed like Sensei's dad was a naughty guy (to no one's surprise.)

Sensei's favorite flower is established as the sunflower, perhaps indirectly confirming Ayane meant to name the shapeshifter's Himawari.

Oh, Niki's affection cannot decay. Interesting. If even Noriko's affection decayed, I guess she likely is one of the top 3 people who "love" Sensei the most. Meanwhile, this new Maya here still has a solid 356 in my affection tracker... did it even get lower until now? Suspicious.

Is this Wires talking? It sounds surprisingly kind... (last event narrator.)

The rest I forgot to write down.

Some musings regarding neo-Maya:
I'm kinda enjoying this new Maya. At first, I didn't care about her and thought she was being a little too rude... I feel. On the other hand, it was very nice seeing a Maya who seemed to not be suffering so greatly. Light of heart enough to enjoy herself during the D&D session, acting reasonably normally, and genuinely engaging in social events.

Also enjoyed the short Maya-Molly moment. I feel like they could be good friends to each other, unexpectedly. Though, I wonder what inspired Molly to kill her off. Of course, I know the second half of that event is supposed to be more or less an allegory regarding Sensei's condition and whatnot. Yet, this feels more meta than anything from the author's part.

Well, neo-Maya is obviously hiding something: she can react to the time loop story, which is unusual in the first place. And I feel like she avoided Niki rather than Noriko. She's a bit hard to decipher for now. A good guess is one raised previously in this thread: neo-Maya is currently in an illicit relationship with Sensei and must act beneath suspicion by feigning disinterest and disdain. We know she can pretend well through her Dorm Wars maid event, so this doesn't seem like it would be hard for her.
Above average update in my view. Specially due to a certain bottle game...

Well that was both a horrible and wonderful update for me. Very depressing, frustrating, and sad which is probably what Sel wanted.

Some of my unintelligent ramblings...
Maya so depressing, couldn't figure out if she remembers past with Akira or not, at one point it seems she did and other points not. Definitely seemed to remember hating the pink sisters. I am just lost without her.

Makoto very cutthroat and I do not care for that. I didn't think she would make it to the roof but what do I know.

Annie Wilkes Ami was scary. I get she is insane but jeez, I got so excited when Io and Uta showed up, what a letdown for me. I am not enjoying these crazy lust scenes of hers, but got to get 100% on main playthrough.

I wanted Ayane to do something more so badly but it didn't happen.

Wakana scene was great. Really enjoyed the Niki Norriko talk as well. Damn was hoping they would do something about Ami.

Line toward the end said this would be the saddest chapter, so in the Dark part now?

Not cool of Sel to makes us wait again for AKira to wake up. I am hopeful he will next update but who knows, maybe more gal only events.

Was that Daisy at the end that turned off the auto pilot? Then it got turned right back on? What was the A name the smart peeps decided on for her, I want to use that in my next PT.

Guessed right that Sana was the new chapter icon, at the end of 35 Akira says something about those 4 girls so that's why I though she would be the one.

Probably have more but its time to read what all the smart peeps think so I can try to understand things.

Some things.

Pretty much at the start of this update.
Behind some bush? on the roof, there's a flat chested girl hiding.
I guess thats Ami, further increasing the likelihood that she knows a shit ton more about whats going on that she lets on.
The rest of the update made it even more clear.

Could still be another girl, with decreasing probability, like Sana or Maya, in that order.

I see people here differentiating between a Prime- and a sub? Maya?
As is see it, there's not much difference.
It's the same physical being.

The "new" Maya is the Maya we know, just stripped of the memories related to the cycles. Not a copy.
At least i think so. What gives it away is that Maya mentiones a headache she's having, early on.
Would make no sense to mentioned that, if it wouldn't have a meaning.
Additionally, it was mentioned, by whatever narrator, that it would be possible to get Maya back.

So it seems that Pareidolia is as fucked up as the other "two" "gods" seem to be.
All that "i'm your friend" talk my ass.

That Sel makes them "bleed together", smells extremly fishy. And i saw someone else pointing that out too.

At least it seems that Himawari isn't all that cool with how things go (smth like: "i hope Us can reform? blah blah" whatever) even if she has to work against Pareidolia, reinforcing that she does normally work with/for it.

JelF547 said:
It isn't realy bad, but can you remember worse update?
Click to expand...
33, 34 and first half of 35 ?
I'm starting to worry about the future of the game.

The author needs to show the development of the characters, their relationships and sort out what he mixed up. Hence there is a lot of dialogue, empty often.

In this update much was expected and the question was not "what" but "how".
Ami died and will come back? Expected.
Maya has been reset and there will be a new one? There was a possibility that it would be deleted and forgotten, but that was unlikely..
Sensei will suffer? We've already seen vegetable Sensei, not a big surprise.
Psycho Ami protects Sensei from everyone? Not news.
We were shown how others suffer without a Sensei. No surprises. We knew this, but the author had to show it.

And again, serious events are left behind the scenes (Otoha and Rin’s breakup, Chika's moving)

The only one surprise added - who was Ami talking to in her monologues? This is definitely not Sekai (Ami she would be happy to see her mother). Another Ami (“Broken Ami”)? But why?

Therefore, my assessment of the update is “could have been better”. Let's hope this is just the seed for the new chapter.

Personally, Chika is the girl that seems to be losing it the most:
Chika - "Now, you have a cool rocker chick slash...semi-gyaru...thing. I don't know! I'm having an Identity crisis!"
Yumi - "So, on a scale of one to ten, where do you think you'd rank yourself right now in terms of utter insanity?"
Chika - "This many."
Chika's main characteristic also seems to be being delusional, always seeing and hearing what she wants to:
Every day I spend with Chika is one day closer to realizing that she lives in a world of blissful ignorance, where only the things she wants to hear manage to stick to whatever part of the brain stores memories.

Not to mention, Maya Prime being so nice to Ami and Sana throughout the game, might have been hinting at her considering them dangerous.

Meanwhile, Ami is obviously disturbed, but even throughout this whole update, where she's demonized by everyone, it's shown she actually was taking care of Sensei, and expected Sensei to recover soon:
Ami - "Don't worry, though! I'm sure you'll be strong enough to leave the house and go visit there soon if you keep improving at the rate you have been!"
(Before a certain event may have broke him all over again.) Psycho Ami continues seeming like an exaggeration, and there was plenty of reasons for her to start butchering and sodomizing this update.

Sana on the other hand loves horror, gore, and violence. Also, seems to like rape as well. Sana is becoming someone to be a little wary of. Especially considering that this is her, and The Dark's chapter, and it seems like the love story is over, with Sana herself acting differently, or simply more true to herself. Her innocence even seems to be a facade, which Nodoka has continously hinted at:
Nodoka - "I'm telling you, Sensei. She's a freak, I can feel it."
- "Timid Angel by day, closet nympho by night. I'm calling it now."
- "Ahh...the way she feigns such innocence never fails to captivate me so. I can already feel the creative juices beginning to drip down my thighs."

Perhaps Ami and Sana are even intended to be analogous to eachother. Ami acts insane, but is actually harmless. Sana acts innocent, but is actually dangerous. Possibly hinted at by how they are paired when it comes to the dorms:
I suppose we'll find out.

posts.content_html_raw:
So, the general consensus I've seen from this community seems to be that this update wasn't great, that it left out a bunch of scenes that would have been nice to see, and that it just wasn't very interesting. But that it was setting up for chapter 4 so it's not that weird that the update was boring.
But this thing is, it really didn't need to be.
This update wasn't short at all. The issue is, like half of it was spent on pareidolia nonsensically rambling. It was a lot. It got to the point where I would audibly groan every time more narration popped on the screen. I just feel like this update could've honestly been great if we had seen the breakup, if we had seen Chika accept moving into the new apartment, if we had seen the girls dying their hair. I would've left this update feeling like I watched some major plot developments unfold instead of feeling slightly...bored. And those events could have easily fit in this update if there was just less time spent on word vomit.

And really, this update makes me a bit worried about the future "dark route" of the game. Because, to be perfectly honest, as great as selebus is at writing characters and dialogue, he is genuinely very very not good at writing horror or cryptic scenes. Those parts of the game have felt tedious, and I say this as someone who loves stories with horror and cryptic elements to them, as well as the denpa genre as a whole. But horror isn't scary when it goes on for paragraphs and paragraphs with nothing happening. And when clues or cryptic messages aren't scattered throughout the game to find if you want, but are instead literal essays about nothing that take up half an update, they just become obnoxious. It's like the difference between dark souls, that scatters clues about its lore throughout the game, versus cyberpunk who chooses to explain its lore through hours of exposition about fictional technology that nobody cares about.

I just hope selebus's idea of a "dark route" doesn't involve putting plot on the back burner in favor of rambling for entire updates.

Was really disappointed with this update for the Ami parts at least.
All these updates of her getting better and learning to tone down the obsessiveness, then Ayane confronting her and getting her to cut the manipulative bullshit and in one fell swoop all these events disappear like morning dew, all that growth gone into thin air and she's back to chapter 1 except now she also verbally abuses her friends and acts confrontationally instead of making one off-threats that could be taken as jokes.
Click to expand...
It's not really that Ami regressed, it's just that Sensei broke, right after she gave him space, and he needs her again like he did back when she was 7.

The circumstances are what regressed, and as Ami hints at, this isn't actually something new for them:
Ami - "Wow, you must be in a really bad spot if you're not even going to respond on auto pilot."
- "That reminds me, though -- you have a lot more acquaintances now than you had the last time you were broken. And stopping them all from trying to see you sounds like a pain."
- "No one knows what's better for my uncle than I do because I have done this before."
- "It's you and me against the world. Again. But we've fought this fight before. We just need to hang on a little bit longer and we'll have the life we've always wanted."

Sensei and Ami even have a "sanity-pack":
Sensei - "Ami. Fetch me my sanity-pack."
Ami - "Here you go, Sensei! These items will help keep you sane while you're locked in here indefinitely."

If it wasn't for the break in, things would have probably even went back to normal, soon, like Ami implied:
Ami - "Don't worry, though! I'm sure you'll be strong enough to leave the house and go visit there soon if you keep improving at the rate you have been!"
- "I'm just glad our house is so safe, you know? Especially with all the extra stuff I've done to make sure nobody can hurt you in here. But it's not like we'll need that forever!"
- "Once you're all better, we can take down the locks and you can go back to being a teacher like you've always wanted!"
But now, Ami and Sensei are probably even worse off than they were two months ago. Ami and Sensei have realized they aren't safe and Ami can't protect Sensei like this:
Ami - "You're right. It isn't safe here anymore..."
And Ami at least seems to be losing it more than ever:
Ami - "Shut up! I told you to shut up!"

The more I read everyone's post, the more I feel like what happened to Maya isn't just "reverting to a chronologically previous state".

If the only thing removed from Maya's memory is the experience related to the endless cycle, her love for him technically will stand. The withstood old toxic dynamic between her and Noriko (or Niki) tracks with that too. However, what is massively contradicting is new Maya's seemingly genuine indifference to Sensei's current state.

Though it could be because this illicit relationship is supposed to be kept secret at all costs, but if that's the case Maya would be prioritizing "being secretive" or "letting Ami's guard down first and swapping in for the kill" over "simply loving someone", putting the cart before the horse. Especially since old Maya is one of the people that knows how much pain Akira's bad mental state was causing him even before the cycle began, it's just really odd for her to be such unfazed.

Thus I can't help but consider the possibility of yet another incoherent character rewriting done by this god awful world. This time it's not just Maya's cosmic knowledge, but her feelings for Akira as well, reducing her attitude toward him to just a friend's creepy uncle. However, the imperfect part is that first, her hatred for Noriko remains while the reason of that hate has already gone; second, the story on Noriko's side is left unrevised, the same with Maki's POV toward Makoto's bluejay incident.

Therefore this new Maya does not think she is in love with Akira, as that part of the memory has been pulled from the root. So if she really is the key to wake Akira up, she needs to wake up as well, her "false memory" needs to be confronted by the last witness of that memory, Noriko. Without someone else pressing your false part of the memory and attempting to get to the bottom of it, girls will just shake it off with an "A-Anyway", or remain oblivious; the current Maya is no exception to this.

In hindsight, removing not only her time loop experience but also her love for him sounds like a more proper, and much more cruel punishment for Akira. I mean if he wakes up with Maya constantly being like this, is that really a punishment? LOL


Anyway, I hope I am wrong. I miss old Maya too.

Therefore this new Maya does not think she is in love with Akira, as that part of the memory has been pulled from the root. So if she really is the key to wake Akira up, she needs to wake up as well, her "false memory" needs to be confronted by the last witness of that memory, Noriko. Without someone else pressing your false part of the memory and attempting to get to the bottom of it, girls will just shake it off with an "A-Anyway", or remain oblivious; the current Maya is no exception to this.
In hindsight, removing not only her time loop experience but also her love for him sounds like a more proper, and much more cruel punishment for Akira. I mean if he wakes up with Maya constantly being like this, is that
really
a punishment? LOL
Anyway, I hope I am wrong. I miss old Maya too.

Something to consider -- when Akira woke up after being reset, he didn't just lose knowledge of everything after the resets began, he lost EVERYTHING. He didn't know who Ami was, he didn't know who Maya was, and Maya was terrified of him finding out because the last time(s) he had, it literally broke him. Hell, he didn't even know who HE was for a time.

It is entirely likely that Maya is going through something similar (though very obviously not identical), where large chunks are gone and have to be recovered organically -- and very likely in a set order, much like Akira had to learn quite a few things before he could even hear his NAME without blanking out.

And the horror of the next few chapters could well be watching some of that progress begin to manifest only to have her brain break due to some minor slip-up and they have to start over again.

In hindsight, removing not only her time loop experience but also her love for him sounds like a more proper, and much more cruel punishment for Akira. I mean if he wakes up with Maya constantly being like this, is that
really
a punishment? LOL
Anyway, I hope I am wrong. I miss old Maya too.
Click to expand...
Something to consider -- when Akira woke up after being reset, he didn't just lose knowledge of everything after the resets began, he lost EVERYTHING.  He didn't know who Ami was, he didn't know who Maya was, and Maya was terrified of him finding out because the last time(s) he had, it literally broke him.  Hell, he didn't even know who HE was for a time.
It is entirely likely that Maya is going through something similar (though very obviously not identical), where large chunks are gone and have to be recovered organically -- and very likely in a set order, much like Akira had to learn quite a few things before he could even hear his NAME without blanking out.
And the horror of the next few chapters could well be watching some of that progress begin to manifest only to have her brain break due to some minor slip-up and they have to start over again.

I don't think Sana is entirely indifferent towards Sensei romantically (or even regarding his well-being, in general); ever since some God flipped her switch, she has been, for the most part, only focused on getting off. Lust "overrode" her reason and empathy. Mildly.

A while back I was contemplating on Sensei's reaction upon learning Tsuneyo's full name ("that sounds like a samurai"), so I start looking up all their names haphazardly from time to time. If you are reading this. Please do not come looking for me.
chances are it was time for me to leave already. And I don't want
to make you hurt even more than I'm sure you're already hurting.
Take care of yourself okay? Id say "I know you've always struggled with
that" or something similar but lets face it. That alone wouldn't do
your misery justice.
I don't remember how I used to be. Or what I used to like. Or...much
about the past since its all so far away now. But I hope you'll be
kind to me.
Or whatever is left.

It's curious that this update is shorter than the average for the last year or so ("only" 50k words) and also seems longer / more padded out / more tiresome to many of us here. As some have mentioned, I am also highly confident that Selebus ran out of time for his planned material and, considering the release date more important than the result, constructed this update from what he could throw together before the year-end deadline.

I was happy with the developments this time around despite that, but I hope we'll have a return to form next month with a somewhat higher signal-to-noise ratio. I like the theory that the event Times New Roman is playing out in Akira's head as he languishes. Also hoping he is saved from his catatonic state by Ayane, though I think it's possible that he remains lost in his head for the entire chapter. I'm morbidly intrigued by the prospect of his becoming "The Collector".

On another note, the unused track 'fallishere.mp3' goes extraordinarily hard.

spoilers.html: What did you want to be when you were little? I bet it was something fun like an astronaut or a policeman. What you didn't want to be, though, was someone who grew up alone. Someone who sits in their room each night, staring at the wall and wishing to be absorbed by it. Swallowed whole, even. What your parents should have told you when you came to them with that dream is that dreams do not come true unless you are willing to go to extremes to obtain them. They will not come true unless you change the world to fit your desires. I worry about you, you know? I'm very concerned. I think about you almost constantly. Never in a sexual manner or anything like that, just a normal manner. I consider us friends. You and I have always been friends, haven't we? Do you remember the nights you used to talk to me before going to sleep? How you'd tell me all of your problems and I'd just sit there listening? Those were some of my favorite nights of all. But you never told me about those dreams of how you wanted to be an astronaut. You only told me the bad things. How family members were sick or how you were afraid of failing a test. Things like that. Why don't you ever tell me anything happy? Why don't you ever thank me for being there for you? I gave you everything. I hear your voice as if it's my own. It is my own. Everything you have is mine. It's all mine and I'm still nothing. We're all nothing. Nothing and everything. I wish I was never born.

This overly complicated idea has been sitting at the back of my head for a while, so perhaps dishing it out and letting others polish/destroy it would be better. It's about Maya again.

She has been portrayed as a very unique yet extremely mysterious girl the whole time: mature and special enough at wizard age to remind Akira of himself, entirely unclear backstories, an unexplainable tie to the merciless gods, etc. This combo sprouted into some believable theories postulating her real origin being a goddess in punishment for falling in love with a mortal.

Putting the god stuff aside, her extremely mysterious background should be something established prior to any time fuckery took place, and thus shouldn't be erased just because she got reset, right? Despite apparently losing all knowledge to the cycle and all affinities to Akira, this new Maya is still someone that "just showed up in town one day" with made up family contact info, right? Is the new Maya now like a messiah in dormancy, or a messiah too good at pretending not to care about the current broken Sensei? Or is she really just a normal fucking teenager now?

So here comes the complicated part:
What if time fuckery started instead all the way back in a way so complicated that Maya's defining characters (which include her love for him and her dubious background) are in fact all products to time fuckery?
To explain this, the following is currently how I've been conceiving the order of fateful events.

straightforward, linear(ish), requires minimum assumptions.

The convoluted idea is the following:

More than half of these have no way of proving themselves to be believable, but the idea behind is to find a way to rationalize a hypothesis, in which "Maya's love for him as well as her backstories are also a product of time fuckery and thus are perishable with resets if failed to pass".

Again, this is something with holes and without concrete proof, just gut feelings based off fragments of dialogues and my own biased affinity for timeline-jumping plots.
Second Sun

This looks like an effort to distinguish them supernatural, divine, universe-related entities from Maya. Combining with Maya's own incessant self intro as a normal fucking teenager, maybe there is an ounce of truth in there? That Maya's very root is in fact really just a plain human girl?

The timeline jumping part is inspired by Memories where Maya "journeyed" back to her tutoring past that gave me an everlasting impression, her use of the word "timeline" when reuniting with Noriko in What Could Have Been, and overall character similarity between Maya and Homura from Madoka Magica.

posts.content_html_raw:
Ayo everyone, I don't think I'm a novice to this game but I'd like introduce myself first. I stumbled upon it since last September and I kept poring over it ever since then. I have made it to the middle of Second Christmas (not a native speaker therefore pardon for my tardy peruse), lurking all the time on this web. I think the game is very intriguing in many many ways, bewildering as well. I have some question and inadequate reflections to share about. And I'm glad to see everybody discuss friendly here.

Anyways get down to brass, first thing I want to ask is about gods that prevailed all over this place. I have encountered word God imprecating by characters with capitalized G was substitued with little g for several occasions. Is that a suggestion that those gods are not actual omnipotent beings rather than USERS monitoring the Terminal 23 system as some parts of reset events hit?

The first god that is Nozumu (望? Hope? Is that big angel an incarnation of him?), speaking in all capitalized letters, seems like a huge jerk with sheer lust to deflower every girl due to unknown reason. Motivation iss nevertheless clear and he is the one often "fizzes" the screen and takes over control of Sensei as far as I saw in many events? Isn't Sensei's deceased brother eponymous with it too? Did he apotheosize to a god? Which is highly plausible in my opinion since Teacher (Sensei's sister-in- law Sekai who also passed away in that accident it seemed) said blatantly that Brother had done so much abominable conductions to her in the very recent Happy Event...

Let's move to The Second one, the one I reserved most confusions. He's the Wire god initating lines with a huge amount of blackslashes, and has unknown relationship with Tsuneyo's Father. (Wiring upstair connecting to his life-sustaining machine, even Nozumu wanted to invade Tojo's Ramen, etc.) But I have no idea what's his deal is? Does he want to protect the sysytem and assist Sensei? That's possible since he took care of Miku and helped us sizing the control of Nozumu in Yumi's Abyss event. But he's also the one who played a serious and even traumatized joke on Maya during first Dorm War and mind-controlled Sensei deflowering Molly (And reset it back afterwards? Because clearly Molly is a virgin now). Like for what reason? Also I have noticed that in Yumi's Abyss event he spoke in lower case while in others he always spoke with all capitalized letters? Did other gods impersonate him...?

The Third one, also known as The Concerned, haven't showed up yet.

That's my cursory synopsis so far and there are so many mysteries for me. I hope anyone of you can answer it. I won't mind moderate spoilers. Apologize beforehand for probable grammatical errors.

I've talked about the gods a few times before, if you want to use the search bar, you can probably find my past posts.

Anyway, the gods and users seem connected:
  • USER1 seems to be the First god mentioned, aka The Callous, The Lust Eater, Nozomu, and likely HOPE. Tends to talk in all caps "LIKE THIS". It's season is Summer.
  • USER2 is likely the Second god mentioned, aka The Calm, and The Wire god. Tends to talk in all caps with slants "/////LIKE THIS". It's season is Winter.
  • USER3 is the Third god mentioned, aka The Concerned, The Dark, and later on calls itself Pareidolia. Tends to talk in lower case, but can change it up whenever apparently. This is likely the one you saw talking in lower case. It's season is Spring.
Terminal 23 seems to be this World, but it isn't exactly clear yet. USERS and gods are somewhat interchangeable.

Why the First god aka The Callous shares a name with Sensei's brother isn't clear, but it's possible that it is simply the name the Narrator chose to give it. Nozomu can translate to Hope. Not to mention, who the Narrator telling us about the gods, is, also isn't clear. Also, probably should mention that USER1 has apparently account shared before, which makes things even more confusing.

As for what USER2/The Second god seems to want? Well, presumably it wants order:
Narrator - "Because somewhere in this god's code, there was a line or two stating that he must maintain order."
Out of all of the gods and USERS, this one seems be the one behind the resets, memory alteration, and perception alteration that's likely going on. It's been noted that this god can:
Narrator - "Sometimes, if he's controlling the right person, he can make some visual alterations as well."
At least alter visuals, and certain events like 'The Scary Room' Main Event, show that Maya at least thinks it could reset her. Not to mention, stuff like affection points seem to be it's thing. The game parts of this game seems to be it's domain.

Overall: It's not impossible that The Second god may be the system itself, or at least has control over it.

The First god seems to want this power, hence HOPE being implied to want something to do with wires and Sensei's special ability. Ironically, this Callous god may be the only one that's actually on Sensei's side, at least in theory, whether that's a "good" thing is up to you.

The Third god on the other hand seems to just want to make things how it thinks things should be.

Also some notable spoilers are that all 3 of these gods apparently gave Sensei his body, can't feel on their own, and require sacrifices that more or less translate to Sensei taking things that don't belong to him. They seem to need Sensei to fuck specific girls to maintain their power.

Lessons in Love Android Port [v0.36.0]


Download APK(100 MB)- Pixeldrain
Download Data(2.32 GB)- Pixeldrain
​

Installation Tutorial
  1. Uninstall the previous version, old save may work since nothing much change, but can cause crash due to the removal of the Guide Mod.
  2. Download APK
  3. Install it
  4. Run APK and allow Storage Permission
  5. Wait until the app closes itself (crashes)
  6. Download the data.rpa
  7. Copy/ cut it to Storage/Documents/Cids/com.cidports.lil/game
  8. Make sure the folder structure is the same as below
    • Documents
      • Cids
        • com.cidports.lilhd
          • game
            • data.rpa
  9. If you have done these steps correctly, the game should play properly with no missing images or crashes.

Android Gestures
  • Swipe Up - Shows Menu
  • Swipe Down - Hide UI
  • Swipe Left - Back
  • Swipe Right - Skip
Other Features (In game's settings page and not a standalone page like before)
  • Customizable Textbox Transparency
  • Customizable Text Size (Dialogues)
External saves in Documents/Cids

Why not all in one package/ APK?
Because the installations are invalid (at least on my tested devices) if the package size is above 2GB, and lowering the quality more than this would make it very ugly to look at.

Please let me know if there is any issues, and if not and works for you, maybe give me a .

spoilers.title: Installation Tutorial
spoilers.html:
Installation Tutorial
  1. Uninstall the previous version, old save may work since nothing much change, but can cause crash due to the removal of the Guide Mod.
  2. Download APK
  3. Install it
  4. Run APK and allow Storage Permission
  5. Wait until the app closes itself (crashes)
  6. Download the data.rpa
  7. Copy/ cut it to Storage/Documents/Cids/com.cidports.lil/game
  8. Make sure the folder structure is the same as below
    • Documents
      • Cids
        • com.cidports.lilhd
          • game
            • data.rpa
  9. If you have done these steps correctly, the game should play properly with no missing images or crashes.

That's a big reason I try to show the screenshots. But actually, it could be the other way around.

I'd think if Nodoka had seen Sekai even as a hallucination, she'd probably realize that Ami and her, look too much alike to not be related. She's just now realizing they are related because their poetry was similar. Probably didn't even know Sekai's last name, until now. Maybe not even the name Sekai.

Otoha on the other hand, well, she's apparently trying to pretend she doesn't know Sekai's pseudonym, even from Nodoka. She also didn't seem surprised to find out she was Ami's mother.

For all we know, she and Sekai are connected. Otoha is virtually the only girl that likes the idea of a little brother, as much as Sekai liked her little brother in law. Both of which, even seeing Sensei as that little brother:
Otoha - "You're like a...stupid little brother to me and I don't have anyone else to turn to."
Sensei - "A...Little brother..."
Otoha also shares a few traits that Sekai likely did. Both just happening to be inherently popular, manipulative, and creative, plus they also seem to embrace being shitty people, enjoy power dynamics, and the idea of being with younger boys.

Not entirely sure what the point of Otoha is, but it's becoming likely that it's related to Sekai. She has also seen the Upside Down House though:
Otoha - "The buttons on the TV aren't working either. It's just stuck on some weird picture."
- "Ugh. Keep your money. I'll just eat my doughnuts and watch this weird picture of a house until- Oh. The TV went back to normal."
So, there might be something there.

DeSkel15 said:
I definitely think, if anyone has plot armor in this game, it's Ayane.

The Shapeshifter actually seemed to break the rules to help Ayane, during the last Beach Vacation:
View attachment 3222114 View attachment 3222115 View attachment 3222116 View attachment 3222117 View attachment 3222119 View attachment 3222120 Ayane - "It feels like something out of a fairytale. I was beginning to think I'd be lost out here forever."
Shapeshifter - "Hey, who knows? Without my help, you might have."
Narrator that might be The Shapeshifter - "I did something bad tonight. I've been doing that a lot lately -- getting pickier with the rules I follow and the ones I overlook...but I promise it's all for a good reason!"
Later - "And sure as the sunshine, our lives are in bloom."
The Shapeshifter - "And sure as the sunshine, I'll be watching you closely."
and Ayane may literally have plot armor as part of the plot right now. She seemed confident about things going well for her, recently:
View attachment 3222132 Ayane - "Unfortunately, I promised I wouldn't tell you. It's nothing but good news, though. For me, definitely. And... for all of us, I think. But that last part is more of an expectation than actually knowing."

In a more meta sense, even Sel, during the Rework, deleted Events that made Ayane look bad:
View attachment 3222129 View attachment 3222130
Like when she sucked off Sensei under his desk while Ami was talking about wanting to spend time with him. (It's on Sensei's computer)

There's also how Kirin was incredibly lax with her blackmailing. I mean, don't get me wrong, it was messed up, but Kirin could have and probably would have done way worse, if she was allowed to.

There's not really much of a reason that Kirin wouldn't have Ayane eating her out or be eating her out. Pictures, videos, etc. Instead, there's only like 3 Events related to it, and it began back in Chapter 1 lasting until Chapter 3. That's months if not a year of blackmailing, by someone who rationalizes that sexual assault is okay, according to a Narrator:
View attachment 3222152 Italic Narrator/Maybe The Shapeshifter - "Or the human embodiment of a trash can pretending to be sentient as it leans against the hood of a stranger's car and thinks to itself about why sexual assault is okay so long as the majority of parties orgasm."
and got turned on while thinking Molly was raped while drunk:
View attachment 3222153 Kirin - "Show me the you who lures innocent, drunk girls, away from parties and...fucks them before they even know what's happening."
It's immersion breaking if you really think about it.

I don't necessarily want Ayane to suffer, but I would appreciate something that makes her feel less invincible. Even Paper City showed her as being literally unstoppable:
View attachment 3222180 Paper City Ayane - "I literally just told you that. There's nothing you can do to stop me."
Click to expand...
Ayane is like a daughter to Sel, afterall:
Sel - "And before you get any ideas, no. I'm not talking about you. I'm talking about Ayane- a character who is very close to my heart and, at oftentimes, feels a lot like a daughter to me."

I only really noticed it because one of them flashes in this update ("Miserably Ever After") and I happened to replay it yesterday after listing to said podcast. I don't remember off the top of my head the other events they have been in. I didn't want to look for ages so I pulled the images from the game files.

"La Fontaine de Sang" (The Fountain of Blood) from "Les Fleurs du mal" (The Flowers of Evil) by Charles Baudelaire.



Il me semble parfois que mon sang coule à flots,
Ainsi qu'une fontaine aux rythmiques sanglots.
Je l'entends bien qui coule avec un long murmure,
Mais je me tâte en vain pour trouver la blessure.

À travers la cité, comme dans un champ clos,
Il s'en va, transformant les pavés en îlots,
Désaltérant la soif de chaque créature,
Et partout colorant en rouge la nature.

J'ai demandé souvent à des vins captieux
D'endormir pour un jour la terreur qui me mine;
Le vin rend l'oeil plus clair et l'oreille plus fine!

J'ai cherché dans l'amour un sommeil oublieux;
Mais l'amour n'est pour moi qu'un matelas d'aiguilles
Fait pour donner à boire à ces cruelles filles!

From what have seen looking it up there have been various different translations throughout the years I'll just copy paste one rather than use google translate.
( William Aggeler 1954)

It seems to me at times my blood flows out in waves
Like a fountain that gushes in rhythmical sobs.
I hear it clearly, escaping with long murmurs,
But I feel my body in vain to find the wound.

Across the city, as in a tournament field,
It courses, making islands of the paving stones,
Satisfying the thirst of every creature
And turning the color of all nature to red.

I have often asked insidious wines
To lull to sleep for a day my wasting terror;
Wine makes the eye sharper, the ear more sensitive!

I have sought in love a forgetful sleep;
But love is to me only a bed of needles
Made to slake the thirst of those cruel prostitutes!

Someone (barglenarglezous and maybe another person) did translate at least 1 of the images from what I could find with the thread search. But I don't think anyone posted about this poem yet apologies if someone did.

If you look up Charles Baudelaire's work it seems quite fitting to reference him given the nature of this game. However I know next to nothing about his poetry and poetry in general. So I expect some, or all, the significance of the reference to him is lost on me.

Edit: Just noticed its already on the wiki. Along with all the other poems referenced. It was First used in "Bad News Bears".

posts.content_html_raw:
What are people's thoughts on Makoto joining RAS? I feel like despite getting a new member, we aren't really getting any closer to figuring out the "prerequisite", if there is one that is generally applicable to all girls that is.

Makoto has shown some signs of noticing time fuckery, or has been through major emotional incidences before, but most if not all are scattered between different resets. This includes her suicide, her vaguely remembering coming to the beach, and her father's death. Apparently none of these alone was enough to bring her to the roof during the respective reset (2nd, 3rd, and 5th).

Meanwhile, Ayane did not show many subtle signs of perceiving time fuckery. Her experience is almost exclusively limited to having then losing baby Himawari.

Finally, the temp members Yumi and Tsuneyo. Yumi experienced a big skip in time firsthand but went back to defection mode; Tsuneyo had less directed experience but could still vaguely remember her time on the ferris wheel. Still, these two aren't here with us by the time of 6th reset.

So what do Ayane and Makoto now (and potentially Maya) have in common that separate them from Yumi and Tsuneyo, and the rest of the girls? Particularly, why Makoto shows up now during the 6th rather than the 5th reset?

Aside from a plausible theory about having to experience major trauma (losing your fetus and losing your father), one recent revelation I can think of that can group Ayane and Makoto together, is the "list of girls Akira comes to love" that was kinda abruptly introduced in The Desk Scene imo (for some reason I am still quite bewildered by the fact that Sensei now actually loves Makoto).

Of course not all girls on the list, Makoto/Ami(?)/Ayane/Niki/Maya, make it to the roof, but I am honestly not sure how else I can include Makoto if only looking at the recent development. So I guess I have to accept that either there is only one prerequisite that is different from girls to girls, or there are multiple prerequisites need to be met and they don't have to be done within 2 resets, or all these are still wrong, or there in fact isn't a solid ruling and Sel would just shove a girl up there with merely 1-2 updates worth of buildup.

Pareidolia - "Frankly, that girl had it coming for being such an incorrigible, single-minded bitch all the time."
And didn't like how she groomed Sensei:
Pareidolia - "Not the person she wanted you to be. Not the person she groomed you into -- a broken man incapable of dividing what little love he has left into boxes to share with everyone and everything."

Pareidolia is kind of a dick:
Referring to Maya:
Sensei - "I was being followed by a stray cat."
After losing Maya:
Pareidolia - "Stray cat got your tongue?"

Pareidolia seems fine with Ayane though, albeit, seems to imply it might take her away as well:
Pareidolia - "Or perhaps I need to take something else from you to spur you back to action?"

Yasu - "Then why do you reek of a shrine?"
Sensei - "Second, shrines don't have a scent."
Yasu - "But gods do. And I am very very very very very very very very very very very good when it comes to sniffing out things like that, Sensei."
Maya's also implied she's made wishes before:
Maya - "This is not what I wished for!"
And Maya just happening to find out the rooftop is a safe zone is suspicious to me, tbh:
Maya - "Oh, I don't really know. I just kind of went there the first time the world ended because strange things tend to happen on rooftops in a lot of the manga and games I read."

Maya is also one of the only girls confirmed to be familiar with Denpa:
Maya - "Probably just a denpa trope. Either way, that's where you'll want to be."
And the only girl that's actually tried hiding people from Sensei:
Noriko - "What you don't do is hide them from everyone else who cares about them and make them think they're all alone! That is being obsessed Maya!"
The Nakayamas in particular.

Ironically, the way Noriko describes Maya, seems to be how people see Ami:
Noriko - "You're insecure...and controlling...and selfish...and malicious...and you'd hurt anyone who stands in your way if it means getting to keep Akira wrapped around your finger."

I'm still wondering how New Maya might react to finding out Sensei has other girlfriends, though. New Maya might give us a clue as to how the resets began.

posts.content_html_raw:
So I finally got to play the generic events already made for chapter 4 and... it's probably nothing but there's something that caught my attention. You can see Akira's new state of mind in them: moping around, longing for Maya, self destructive thoughts, broken by Ami, his loss of appetite for life overall. The girls he spends time with are almost an afterthought.

Except when it comes to Yumi: In both of her generic events I can see the same old Akira in there and ultimately he openly express his desires of winning her over. The charm of pursuit is still there and those were the only times I felt he's not completely dead inside now. So I wonder if this is a clue on how chapter 4 will play out, if he's going to see Yumi as the outlet for his pent up grievings. I know is a small sample size, a lot of generic events are not done yet and most of the ones we have are from girls he already conquered. But from what we have so far, the contrast is quite notorious.

Hello Deskel, much obliged to your response. You seems like a Lore master to ask.

I brushed up on some Happy Events I've even encountered and fashioned a few more theories. I'd like to hear what would you think of them.

First, the association between Nozumu and HOPE is very ambiguous and I always presumed they were one entity with different perception. However, I've found tons of hints suggesting Nozumu was already dead (God is dead) and tried to come back at any cost (Poor John, do you have any idea why it's User 2 who erased his personality? To prevent infos as much as possible from Sensei?) while HOPE is clearly alive and lived with his angels at the bottom of everything. (room of clocks) I would like to assert that "Something was buried underneath" should be carcass of Nozumu since it's always mentioned in or around Old District that was under his influence (Probably Tojo's Ramen was an exclave of User2 to spy on Nozumu?).

Anyway, I'm starting to doubt if HOPE is the emissary of The Concerned God- That is, if I have to guess on who User 3 is, it's highly possible that the narrator who always encourged and comforted Sensei was the authentic identity of it. My intuition told me it should be Sekai now that she's the only one knew many secrets of Sensei. And Sekai held grudges towards Maya, therefor suffered 61 (old memory remainder of Maya?) a lot in room of clocks.

Furthermore, HOPE, Maya and Sekai the narrator all had implication with the Sky. In the end of First Beach travel where narrator told you a story tree. One of the flash image depicts countenance of HOPE with many smile faces in sky above a tree struting from ground. HOPE also called himself "the feathered kind" and in Trinity III, Sensei said to himself that he started to lose hope, he could never ever rise his head, at the very moment as HOPE started to talk in lower case. (sized by Nozumu or Sekai?)

And it brings out the question about which god does Yasu pray for and entrust with. At first glance she was obviously a follower of Nozumu, either because of her purpose of letting Sensei defiling every girl and ascending to an angel or her parables with "The one with many eyes", one of the epithets attributed to Nozumu in Happy Events. We nevertheless only saw symbol of Cross and Cruification in HOPE's realm. "Sound of cicadas", her introduction event, was a phrase used by HOPE to describe himself. Nor does she like summer much. What if Nozumu has always took the control over HOPE and pretended he was User3? What do you say?

It all jumbles up. Now, I simply cannot get my head around it. Things no longer add up as they used to be...
Click to expand...
Keep in mind that in Yasu's and The New Hope's church faith, there is no death:
Yasu - "There is no death. Just a second plane of existence. A plane much greater than this."

A god being dead, especially the one she seems to follow would equate to a god being on a second plane of existence. Frankly, her story about the person who was born blind, sewn eyes to himself, then died and saw through the lives of others, seems to be the origin story of her god. This was mentioned in Yasu's 'Sakura Season' Event:
Yasu - "Eventually, the man was covered in eyes. And yet, he was just as blind as he was when he was born."
In other words, her god seems to have became a god after it died. Sensei's brother, Nozomu, dying, then HOPE showing up could be why they are equated. HOPE can also translate to Nozomu in japanese.

HOPE has also been mentioned to have many eyes:
Angel Maya - "He has so many of them!"
Sensei - "It has beautiful eyes, but I'm unfortunately only able to see two of them."
Like Yasu's god:
Yasu - "There is only one god. A god of infinite eyes. But there are forces in this world that would have people believe otherwise."
Sensei and The Player can only apparently see two of those eyes.

John also seems to sound like HOPE:
HOPE - "FEED ME EVERYONE YOU LOVE."
John - "FEED.......ME.......
So, if there is a ressurection going on, it'd probably involve HOPE when it comes to John.

Btw, Yasu loves the Summer:
Yasu - "Deep down inside, you love the summer. The same way we do."
But does not like the Winter:
Yasu - "We were fortunate enough to have His Holiness intervene and provide us several hours of warmth, but his power can only do so much in winter time."
- "Once the sun is gone, he will slumber once more. And everything will go back to being a heaping pile of shit."
Fun fact, if Yasu is wearing mostly black, it's probably Summer. If she's wearing mostly white, it's probably not.

Overall: It's very likely that the god called Nozomu, The Callous god, and HOPE, as well as Yasu's god are all the same thing.

Now, as for the confusing parts, I think you've conflated USER2 and USER3 with other things. USER3 is Pareidolia, The Concerned God, and The Dark. It usually talks in lower case. HOPE doesn't. HOPE has had seemingly nothing to do with USER3/Pareidolia so far.

It also probably wasn't USER2 who affected John. John was presumably talking about The World Itself, hence it mentioning "tendrils"
John - "Bacawk. (It comes again in purest form. Tendrils dripping with the blood of my brothers and yet you stand here, idling. Waiting for the snow to melt."
And Yasu seemed extremely scared of the tendrils of sky:
Yasu - "You should run while you still have the chance. You should wrap your arms around those you cherish snd escape to an area outside the grasp of the sky's mighty tendrils-"
Which seem to come from The World Itself, as that was the thing Yasu was talking about at the time:
Yasu - "This is not His word, but the word of the world itself."
This might be the thing that scared John and made him incomprehensible. Albeit, the World Itself is somewhat of a mystery. It seems to be related to The Sky, and Sekai though. It also seems to be somewhat HOPE's opposite, if not perhaps it's Devil, but that's just a theory.

Overall: HOPE shouldn't be an emissary of Pareidolia/USER3, and USER2 probably didn't do anything to John. Yasu also loves the Summer. As for the Tree stuff, that seems to be USER2's thing, but all the gods have some relation to the tree:
"Oh, but we've gotta remember that GOD is THREE gods and that they all joined forces to plant the seed that made your cool new sex-world."
And the universe itself is a forest:
Long Maya - "The universe is a forest."

So, those boxes indicate a Unicode error.
(Unicode is the type standard that allows fonts to display a huge variety of glyphs/characters — simple ones like accents and other diacritical marks, or more complex ones like those from other alphabets/writing systems. Or, in this case, letters displayed sideways to the baseline.)
Either you have a non-Unicode version of a font installed, or the font isn't available at all.

Since most of the fonts involved are embedded in the game, I'm going to guess that it's the first — that you've got a corrupt or non-standard version of a font installed on your computer, and Ren'Py is looking at the installed version before the one embedded in the game file.

Antosha said:
So, those boxes indicate a Unicode error.
(Unicode is the type standard that allows fonts to display a huge variety of glyphs/characters — simple ones like accents and other diacritical marks, or more complex ones like those from other alphabets/writing systems. Or, in this case, letters displayed sideways to the baseline.)
Either you have a non-Unicode version of a font installed, or the font isn't available at all.

Since most of the fonts involved are embedded in the game, I'm going to guess that it's the first — that you've got a corrupt or non-standard version of a font installed on your computer, and Ren'Py is looking at the installed version before the one embedded in the game file.
Click to expand...
I have looked into it now. The game uses "Yu Gothic Medium" for in game text which is a default font in at least win10/11 (and is system protected). I checked the script file and it renders correctly in a text editor with the same font as the game and UTF-8 encoding. So I think its a Ren'Py issue.
I would expect it to be broken for everyone on win10/11. If its not, then I'm not sure what's wrong with it, as it renders as it should outside of Ren'Py.

Yasu - "Red is bad."

Yasu - "I have felt the urge on many occasions to try and speak back to it, but I worry of what God would do to me if I shared my inner voice with anyone but Him."

Yasu - "Because it is not He who gives me these things. These thoughts...It is an interference."

Yasu with Sekai in front of her - "We shall be safe, dilly, dilly,...out of harm's-"

/////////////////"USER2" IS CURRENTLY UNDERGOING MAINTENANCE
In theory, one of the gods, possibly HOPE, is messing it up, but it's not entirely clear yet.

As for it's relation to John, It's possible that something messed with it, which messed up Sensei being able to comprehend John at the time (Hence USER2 going offline temporarily), not entirely sure just yet.

The Mall and The Dark seems to be Pareidolia's/USER3's territory.

DeSkel15 said:
So, I'm assuming you're at least around a chapter behind right? You seem unaware of Pareidolia and stuff in Chapter 3, so I recommend getting caught up. You're missing a lot of info and it's impossible to explain some things without spoiling them if you're behind. If you continue reading, then, well, you've been warned.

Your HOPE/Nozomu/Callous god speculation seems to be missing that he's likely asleep or at least weak in Winter, when the John stuff happens:
View attachment 3272299 View attachment 3272300 Yasu - "But unfortunately, I have to be available for God until he's able to function on his own again."
- "He doesn't handle the cold very well. It makes his legs lock up and his teeth chatter."
We also have HOPE noting that he will be gone for quite some time in the Trinity p3 Happy Event:
View attachment 3272317 HOPE - "THIS WILL BE OUR LAST MEETING FOR QUITE SOME TIME"
And it doesn't seem to truly return until 'The Light of Last Summer' Main Event:
View attachment 3272320 View attachment 3272321 View attachment 3272322 View attachment 3272323 Angel 1 - "Winter is over! Summer has come!"
Angel 2 - "Summer is here! Fun in the sun!"
Angel 1 - "Did he enjoy his time away?"
HOPE - "IT APPEARS YOU HAVE HAD A BUSY SEASON"

Chapter 1 is in Summer. HOPE'S season. Chapter 2 is in Winter. USER2/The Wire god's season. Chapter 3 is in Summer again. Chapter 4 is now Spring. USER3/Pareidolia's season.

The John stuff and most Chapter 2 stuff, happened when HOPE wasn't really around much. (More about John and The World Itself in a bit)

You also seem to be confusing talking Normally:
View attachment 3272325 HOPE - "You will always be nothing."
With talking in Lowercase as USER3 did:
View attachment 3272329 View attachment 3272331 View attachment 3272332 View attachment 3272333 //////////////USER3 HAS ASSUMED CONTROL OF TERMINAL 23
Pareidolia/USER3 - "//////////////can you see this?"
- "i'm so glad"
- "i was very concerned"
Both of which happened in that Trinity p3 Happy Event you've been referring to. Notice how the Concerned god talking in lower case doesn't even capitalize the first letter of a sentence.

In Chapter 3, during Sana's 'Ad Infinitum', this Concerned god reveals itself and chooses the name Pareidolia:
View attachment 3272345 Pareidolia - "you can call me pareidolia."

As for the Tendrils, If you haven't got caught up yet, you're probably unaware of Sekai and The World Itself stuff. I've already shown Yasu talking about Tendrils, but I should also point out that John mentions a festival before Sensei loses the ability to understand it:
View attachment 3272349 View attachment 3272350 John - "Bacawk. (A festival of tears has pitched its tents in the further corners of this city. We will all rue the day that-)"
Sensei - "I...can't understand him anymore."
Before the end of Chapter 2, during Maya's bday, Sensei and Maya come across an abandoned shrine near the festival they were at:
View attachment 3272356 Maya - Perhaps "Out of order" simply means that this shrine was abandoned by its god?
We also had John mentioning the World before this:
View attachment 3272359 View attachment 3272360 John - "Bacawk. (For I have conquered the world.)"
- "Bacawk. (Which means that it must conquer me in return.)
Taking into account that a Festival, the World, an Abandoned shrine, and Tendrils all seem related, it seems like an outside force affected John, and this force seems to be the one Yasu referred to as the World itself.

Now, things might get a little confusing. The Tendrils, I've mentioned prior, are things both the World Itself and HOPE seem to have. Note however that John mentions blood on the Tendrils it's referring to. Blood of its brothers. Chickens. In HOPE's faith, Birds are Sacred:
View attachment 3272362 Yasu - "Birds are sacred beings in the eyes of He who is so commonly misunderstood. They can pass through planes at will and hear things normal humans can not."
The Callous god is even "The Thing with Feathers":
View attachment 3272370 View attachment 3272371 HOPE - "I AM THE THING WITH FEATHERS"
Callous god/The Lust Eater - "I PROMISE YOU THIS AS THE THING WITH FEATHERS"
It seems unlikely that HOPE would be the one murdering chickens/birds. The World Itself has no such implication though. If anything, based off Yasu implying that the World cannibalizes itself:
View attachment 3272382 Yasu - "And so the ground mixes with the air...and rains down upon the ivy, cannibalizing itself as it recycles energy and becomes stronger in a way much more difficult than simply asking Him for power."
Murdering Chickens, could be a way the World grows stronger. Killing and recycling energy from that which is Sacred to HOPE.

Pareidolia has also implied that something else is growing stronger:
View attachment 3272514 View attachment 3272515 Pareidolia - "but as the days go by, i become stronger. i'm not the only one growing, though."
This is perhaps the World itself.

I've mentioned prior, that the World Itself seems kind of like HOPE's opposite, if not it's Devil, so I might as well explain why. Seeing as how World can translate to Sekai, and HOPE to Nozomu, and both of these beings seem related to these translations, it's a theme they both share. They also both have tendrils, they both seem to like Summer with Sekai/The World Itself being restored in Summer:
View attachment 3272373 Sekai - "Why can't I be with you two?"
In the background "SUMMER is come" appears.
They both use Angels, White vs Black:
View attachment 3272405 View attachment 3272406 View attachment 3272402 View attachment 3272403 White Angel 1 - "Winter is over! Summer has come!"
White Angel 2 - "Summer in here! Fun in the sun!"
Black Angel 1 - "s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶!̶"
Black Angel 2 - "k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶!̶"
They also seem to have different colored Rabbit Watchers, but in reverse order with HOPE's being Black, and World's being White, but I'm not entirely sure on that front.

Anyway, with all these similarities in mind, we should also keep in mind that Yasu says Red is Bad:
View attachment 3272419 Yasu - "Red is bad."
With Sekai and The World Itself seemingly being Red, and Yasu seems to think that her god wouldn't want her to speak with the World Itself:
View attachment 3272421 Yasu - "I have felt the urge on many occasions to try and speak back to it, but I worry of what God would do to me if I shared my inner voice with anyone but Him."
We've also had an interference messing with Yasu:
View attachment 3272521 View attachment 3272522 Yasu - "Because it is not He who gives me these things. These thoughts...It is an interference."
I do think it's plausible that Yasu is being deceived, but I don't think it's HOPE, Nozomu, or her god, etc that's doing it. It might be The World Itself. If so, it might explain Yasu's recent persona:
View attachment 3272527 View attachment 3272531 Yasu with Sekai in front of her - "We shall be safe, dilly, dilly,...out of harm's-"
Yasu in a recent event - "Eat shit and die."

Overall: HOPE and Pareidolia still don't seem related, and the Tendrils that John mentions, that both HOPE and The World Itself seem to have, were likely the World's in that case.

Btw, USER2 has lost connection elsewhere, like when Sensei reached the roof in the third reset in Chapter 2:
View attachment 3272432 View attachment 3272438 /////////////////YOU ARE NOW OUT OF RANGE OF "USER2"
- /////////////////YOU ARE NO LONGER SHARING YOUR SCREEN WITH "USER2"
It seems to also have maintenance issues:
View attachment 3272495 /////////////////"USER2" IS CURRENTLY UNDERGOING MAINTENANCE
In theory, one of the gods, possibly HOPE, is messing it up, but it's not entirely clear yet.

As for it's relation to John, It's possible that something messed with it, which messed up Sensei being able to comprehend John at the time (Hence USER2 going offline temporarily), not entirely sure just yet.

Btw, The Old District seems to be the second god's territory. USER2's/The Wire god's. Not Nozomu's.

The Bottom of Everything seems to be HOPE's/USER1's/Nozomu's territory and is perhaps related to Dreams and Nightmares.

The Mall and The Dark seems to be Pareidolia's/USER3's territory.

The World Itself might claim the sky (perhaps even Kumon-mi?), as it's territory, and if so, to add to how it seems to be the opposite of HOPE, the sky seems to have the opposite of HOPE's upside down smile:
View attachment 3272577 View attachment 3272580 HOPE - "LOOK UP!!!"
Sky - "One day, you are going to be happy."

Oh, and Kaori may be possessed by the World Itself currently:
View attachment 3272585 Sensei - "Who...are you?..."
With John seemingly having Nozomu/HOPE in him, and Kaori having Sekai/World Itself in her, and the recent addition of Nao-chan, who may be a replacement Ami, it almost seems like Ami's and Sensei's family is ressurecting. Things are getting interesting.

View attachment 3272514 View attachment 3272515 Pareidolia - "but as the days go by, i become stronger. i'm not the only one growing, though."

- "i'm so glad"
- "i was very concerned"
Both of which happened in that Trinity p3 Happy Event you've been referring to. Notice how the Concerned god talking in lower case doesn't even capitalize the first letter of a sentence.
In Chapter 3, during Sana's 'Ad Infinitum', this Concerned god reveals itself and chooses the name Pareidolia:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272345
Pareidolia - "you can call me pareidolia."
As for the Tendrils, If you haven't got caught up yet, you're probably unaware of Sekai and The World Itself stuff. I've already shown Yasu talking about Tendrils, but I should also point out that John mentions a festival before Sensei loses the ability to understand it:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272349
View attachment 3272350
John - "Bacawk. (A festival of tears has pitched its tents in the further corners of this city. We will all rue the day that-)"
Sensei - "I...can't understand him anymore."
Before the end of Chapter 2, during Maya's bday, Sensei and Maya come across an abandoned shrine near the festival they were at:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272356
Maya - Perhaps "Out of order" simply means that this shrine was abandoned by its god?
We also had John mentioning the World before this:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272359
View attachment 3272360
John - "Bacawk. (For I have conquered the world.)"
- "Bacawk. (Which means that it must conquer me in return.)
Taking into account that a Festival, the World, an Abandoned shrine, and Tendrils all seem related, it seems like an outside force affected John, and this force seems to be the one Yasu referred to as the World itself.
Now, things might get a little confusing. The Tendrils, I've mentioned prior, are things both the World Itself and HOPE seem to have. Note however that John mentions blood on the Tendrils it's referring to. Blood of its brothers. Chickens. In HOPE's faith, Birds are Sacred:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272362
Yasu - "Birds are sacred beings in the eyes of He who is so commonly misunderstood. They can pass through planes at will and hear things normal humans can not."
The Callous god is even "The Thing with Feathers":
Spoiler
View attachment 3272370
View attachment 3272371
HOPE - "I AM THE THING WITH FEATHERS"
Callous god/The Lust Eater - "
I PROMISE YOU THIS AS THE THING WITH FEATHERS
"
It seems unlikely that HOPE would be the one murdering chickens/birds. The World Itself has no such implication though. If anything, based off Yasu implying that the World cannibalizes itself:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272382
Yasu - "And so the ground mixes with the air...and rains down upon the ivy, cannibalizing itself as it recycles energy and becomes stronger in a way much more difficult than simply asking Him for power."
Murdering Chickens, could be a way the World grows stronger. Killing and recycling energy from that which is Sacred to HOPE.
Pareidolia has also implied that something else is growing stronger:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272514
View attachment 3272515
Pareidolia - "but as the days go by, i become stronger. i'm not the only one growing, though."
This is perhaps the World itself.
I've mentioned prior, that the World Itself seems kind of like HOPE's opposite, if not it's Devil, so I might as well explain why. Seeing as how World can translate to Sekai, and HOPE to Nozomu, and both of these beings seem related to these translations, it's a theme they both share. They also both have tendrils, they both seem to like Summer with Sekai/The World Itself being restored in Summer:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272373
Sekai - "Why can't I be with you two?"
In the background "SUMMER is come" appears.
They both use Angels, White vs Black:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272405
View attachment 3272406
View attachment 3272402
View attachment 3272403
White Angel 1 - "Winter is over! Summer has come!"
White Angel 2 - "Summer is here! Fun in the sun!"
Black Angel 1 - "s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶s̶!̶"
Black Angel 2 - "k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶k̶!̶"
They also seem to have different colored Rabbit Watchers, but in reverse order with HOPE's being Black, and World's being White, but I'm not entirely sure on that front.
Anyway, with all these similarities in mind, we should also keep in mind that Yasu says Red is Bad:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272419
Yasu - "Red is bad."
With Sekai and The World Itself seemingly being Red, and Yasu seems to think that her god wouldn't want her to speak with the World Itself:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272421
Yasu - "I have felt the urge on many occasions to try and speak back to it, but I worry of what God would do to me if I shared my inner voice with anyone but Him."
We've also had an interference messing with Yasu:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272521
View attachment 3272522
Yasu - "Because it is not He who gives me these things. These
thoughts
...It is an
interference
."
I do think it's plausible that Yasu is being deceived, but I don't think it's HOPE, Nozomu, or her god, etc that's doing it. It might be The World Itself. If so, it might explain Yasu's recent persona:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272527
View attachment 3272531
Yasu with Sekai in front of her - "We shall be safe, dilly, dilly,...out of harm's-"
Yasu in a recent event - "Eat shit and die."
Overall: HOPE and Pareidolia still don't seem related, and the Tendrils that John mentions, that both HOPE and The World Itself seem to have, were likely the World's in that case.
Btw, USER2 has lost connection elsewhere, like when Sensei reached the roof in the third reset in Chapter 2:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272432
View attachment 3272438
/////////////////YOU ARE NOW OUT OF RANGE OF "USER2"
- /////////////////YOU ARE NO LONGER SHARING YOUR SCREEN WITH "USER2"
It seems to also have maintenance issues:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272495
/////////////////"USER2" IS CURRENTLY UNDERGOING MAINTENANCE
In theory, one of the gods, possibly HOPE, is messing it up, but it's not entirely clear yet.
As for it's relation to John, It's possible that something messed with it, which messed up Sensei being able to comprehend John at the time (Hence USER2 going offline temporarily), not entirely sure just yet.
Btw, The Old District seems to be the second god's territory. USER2's/The Wire god's. Not Nozomu's.
The Bottom of Everything seems to be HOPE's/USER1's/Nozomu's territory and is perhaps related to Dreams and Nightmares.
The Mall and The Dark seems to be Pareidolia's/USER3's territory.
The World Itself might claim the sky (perhaps even Kumon-mi?), as it's territory, and if so, to add to how it seems to be the opposite of HOPE, the sky seems to have the opposite of HOPE's upside down smile:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272577
View attachment 3272580
HOPE - "LOOK UP!!!"
Sky - "One day, you are going to be happy."
Oh, and Kaori may be possessed by the World Itself currently:
Spoiler
View attachment 3272585
Sensei - "Who...are you?..."
With John seemingly having Nozomu/HOPE in him, and Kaori having Sekai/World Itself in her, and the recent addition of Nao-chan, who may be a replacement Ami, it almost seems like Ami's and Sensei's family is resurrecting. Things are getting interesting.
Click to expand...
Just to add to this, my speculation about The World Itself perhaps having power over Kumon-mi, comes from the recent Halloween party.
Nodoka mentions The World Itself, then Yasu claims the city is moving:
Spoiler
Nodoka - "Through me, you can be forgiven. And all of your misdeeds or sins will be forgotten in the eyes of whichever god you follow, for I have been ordained by the world itself."
Yasu - "I think the city is...Moving..."
If the World Itself really has that kind of power, no wonder Nodoka seems interested in it. She's implied prior that she'd want a god on her side:
Spoiler
Nodoka - "If that's true, having a god on my side seems like it would be a pretty good deal."
and I wonder if she may have found one.

I can’t recall if anyone has sorted them before (props to them if they actually did), probably because many events aren’t designed with solid timestamps due to the free roam part of the game.

Of course there are some events that have obvious chronological orders, but I found plenty of them lack in-universe temporal consequences between them despite arranging them by updates being possible. This gets more noticeable when you’re not just focusing on one girl (I.e., comparing character events among girls)

The best one can do is “this big chunk of events takes place before or after certain major incidents”; student transfers, resets, trips, holidays, etc. Then sort the chunks by stories or, if nothing applies, by updates. But even with this it only gives you a loose time line with way too many gray areas.

The general progression is:
1) Farm affection and move through story scenes until there's a non-animated sex scene with a girl
2) The next time you visit a girl (dorm for the students, home/workplace for side girls), there may be an option to perform the act from that scene again, this version will be animated, and can be repeated whenever you're in free-roam mode.
3) Eventually, you'll reach a point where a girl's next scene is shown in the list with a blue title. That's an invite-over event. The first invite over events are not animated, but again, future invite overs will show a sex act as an action, and that is a repeatable animated scene.

Note: When story progression makes a girl unavailable, because they're avoiding you, you're avoiding them, or you've sworn off sex with each other story-wise, repeatable scenes are temporarily locked out.

I wonder the same. I avoided this game for a good while because I thought it was going to be another cheesy and dumb japanese style VN. But it kept being popped up on the latest update page all the time (when there was an update every two weeks) with some insane ratings. So one day I said "fine, fine you win you persistent fucker". I downloaded it without reading any tags, just briefly the descriptions: school settings, you are a teacher, blah blah ok that's enough.

I started playing and I was like "Oh ok, an Isekai but with actual cool writing, funny dialogues and some characters that look interesting". I was having a blast reading without skipping a line and feeling very relaxed. Some things were a little off putting (I mean, it does start with a suicide afterall)... but that's okay. And then, I suddenly walked into a room of clocks...

That kind of impact is all but gone now for new players (at least for unsespecting players like myself who don't bother reading a tag) and the reason I can't get behind the revamp. Maybe my reaction could've been different had not been spoiled before, who knows. Some things are better addressed (Ayane, Makoto early scenes) but I can´t say I agree with Selebus shoving down our throaths all the fuck up stuff from the very start. A little building before that is better in my opinion, but to each their own.

posts.content_html_raw:
I saw someone mention a desire for Sensei to be less depressed and more directly involved in his own life, trying to figure out what's really going on. I agree; here is an example of the Akira I want to see.


From "I Will Deliver You to the Fireflies"

"Words!"
"Combinations of lines! Compressed into strands with the right amount of pressure and skill!"
"Compact meanings into ropes! Ropes that we can use to bind what we are afraid of losing! To keep it all in one place!"
"Untie me! Remove the bindings in my head and recreate what once lived outside of it!"
"Amalgamation of unwanted flesh! Patchwork carbon being! You are the me who should not be me!"
"{b}YOU HAVE DONE NOTHING!{/b}"
"And you are not even here."

"But I am."
"And I am more sentient than ever."
"For I have discovered what is important in a way that does not thrust me into the darkest pits of this unwanted mind."
"I have LIVED through the end of days and am prepared to face the demons I create or she creates or it creates or demons as a whole."
"I am prepared to fight for what I cherish in the face of the holy and will sodomize the omnipowerful rectum of any intervening god with my dramatically impressive cock."
"This is MY world and MY life and YOU have NO place HERE."

"But she does."
"And looking at her makes me feel normal again."

I am certain this is some manifestation of Akira, considering his note of his "dramatically impressive cock", his theme playing, and the camera pointing directly into his eye for most of the speech.

This marks the high point of his character so far, in my view. The monologue is lucid and determined in a way we've never seen him. But it's transient and seems to be directed at an unknown other. Is this a past, future, or suppressed version of Akira? Does he exist outside the loops? Is a less broken version of himself trapped in his own mind?

If anyone recalls any other instances where (an?) Akira expressed similar emotions, it would be great to see them. Something I've dearly hoped for since Reset 5 is that Akira's journey of self-realization will see him become a high-agency protagonist willing to directly challenge the gods of this world and entities beyond.

An Akira who comes out of these decades of trauma feeling like this diatribe sounds, able to fight demons and gods for what he loves, would be a character worth rooting for. Maybe he's "no protagonist" because he hasn't earned it yet. Maybe the dark route will not be dark for his mind, but dark for the world when he finally takes action.

I doubt we'll see much development in this area for a long time, though it looks to me like there's some evidence here for it. I, for one, would appreciate little more than to eventually see Akira become self-possessed and worthy.

- "The World is not who will burn. It is all of us who live inside of it that will."

Makoto - "There's no need to be ashamed, Sensei. You're doing this for me, remember? Quieting the whispers of a thousand screaming clouds that will one day drench me in their hatred. Can you hear them too?"

Sensei - "As I step outside of it and back into the light, I listen closely to the clouds above- hoping to hear the same screaming Makoto did. Of course, I hear nothing. I never do. Maybe that's why I always feel so alone."

Teacher/Sekai - "You're such a good boy."
