For anyone interested in a little Random Theory Time, then: Makoto might be The World Itself's secret weapon in a way.

I noticed last update that Pareidolia didn't seem aware of who might be behind Makoto getting to the roof:
View attachment 3283580 View attachment 3283581 View attachment 3283589 View attachment 3283602 Ayane - "Sensei...don't move, okay? Not like...you really can right now anyway, but yeah. I'm gonna go talk to Makoto for a second."
Presumably Pareidolia - "Another coin for the piggy bank. I wonder who will take the credit for this one?"
Ayane - "Listen, I know how weird and ridiculous and absurd all of this looks, and I'll do my best to explain it as soon as I can, but now really isn't the time."

The last we had seen of Makoto prior, involved her mentioning a "false moon":
View attachment 3283621 Makoto - "When the false moon is upon us."

Although, what this "false moon" is, isn't entirely clear. (I've begun to wonder if this false moon actually is Pareidolia, but I'm not sure just yet.)

Anyway, keeping in mind that Pareidolia is unaware of who might take credit for Makoto, and we don't actually know who/what the false moon is, then, if we go back to Chapter 3, and look at what led to Makoto getting to the roof in Chapter 4, there is one highly suspect being.

The being that Makoto implies might be speaking to her after she lost her father:
View attachment 3283652 Makoto - "It's like the world itself is speaking to me."

The being that Yasu implied was excited and anticipating Makoto finding out her father was dead:
View attachment 3283660 View attachment 3283664 View attachment 3283675 Yasu - "It's tone is one of excitement...like it is anticipating what will soon befall us."
- "The World is not who will burn. It is all of us who live inside of it that will."
Yasu to Makoto after talking about the World - "I'm sorry for what comes next."

The being who may be related to the screaming clouds that Makoto hears after losing her father:
View attachment 3283736 View attachment 3283737 Makoto - "There's no need to be ashamed, Sensei. You're doing this for me, remember? Quieting the whispers of a thousand screaming clouds that will one day drench me in their hatred. Can you hear them too?"
The clouds that Sensei couldn't hear, which made him feel alone:
View attachment 3283742 View attachment 3283743 View attachment 3283744 View attachment 3283745 Sensei - "As I step outside of it and back into the light, I listen closely to the clouds above- hoping to hear the same screaming Makoto did. Of course, I hear nothing. I never do. Maybe that's why I always feel so alone."
(Keep in mind, this was all before the restoration)

And the same being that seems to like the phrase "good boy", and taking advantage of Sensei, which Makoto also says and did:
View attachment 3283751 View attachment 3283750 Teacher/Sekai - "You're such a good boy."
Makoto - "Good boy...staying quiet when I told you to..."

The World Itself.

On top of this, the World Itself, has been shown to apparently get others to the roof, as what seems like Kaori has gotten to it on the 5th Reset:
View attachment 3283759 Sensei - "I'm glad it's you two I get to do this with."

Overall: Considering Pareidolia isn't behind Makoto getting to the roof, and The World Itself more or less fucked with Makoto most of the Chapter prior which led to Makoto becoming aware and getting to the roof, it seems likely that The World Itself is the one behind Makoto's "survival".

I also don't see why else this being would get Makoto to the roof, except to use her. Maybe it's influence is even what has caused Makoto to talk about betraying Ayane:
View attachment 3283834 View attachment 3283835 View attachment 3283836 Makoto - "Then I guess we'll have plenty of time to become friends before ultimately being forced to betray one another."
- "Things not to say to a girl who just equated the world to one giant competition in which we will all have to betray each other."
Ayane - "Easygoing?! You made our classroom sound like the Hunger Games just a few minutes ago and talked about how we're all going to have to betray one another! That isn't easygoing! It's crazy!"

Could definitely be wrong though.
